title: Why Stop Signs Used to Be Yellow
description:
For about 30 years, most American stop signs were yellow with black letters. The reason they turned red in 1954 comes down to paint.

Full story (6 everyday shapes) on our channel: "Why Coins Have Ridges, Manholes Are Round and Stop Signs Have 8 Sides".

Sources: U.S. Federal Highway Administration, MUTCD history; 1954 MUTCD revision.
